acceptance_criteria: Per-user routing added. Patch routing tests pass.
close_reason: Added is_per_user_property, update_per_user_properties to CalendarsBackend; routing logic in handle_calendar_event_set; 3 routing tests; 26 total pass; clippy clean
description:
**What:** Draft-ietf-jmap-calendars-26 §5.4 defines per-user CalendarEvent properties: keywords, color, freeBusyStatus, useDefaultAlerts, alerts. The handler must route per-user-only patches to a separate backend path.

**Algorithm:**
1. Add static fn is_per_user_property(prop: &str) -> bool to CalendarsBackend.
2. Add fn update_per_user_properties(&self, account_id, id, patch) → default delegates to update_object.
3. In handle_calendar_event_set update loop: if all top-level patch keys are per-user → call update_per_user_properties. Otherwise → update_object.
4. Document: backend MUST store per-user properties separately for shared calendars; default is single-user only.

**Tests:**
- Patch {"keywords":{}} → update_per_user_properties called.
- Patch {"title":"New"} → update_object called.
- Mixed patch {"keywords":{},"title":"New"} → update_object called.

**Acceptance criteria:** cargo test -p jmap-calendars-server exits 0.
title: Add per-user calendar property routing contract to CalendarsBackend
